name: claude-code-statusbar
description: Local-only Claude Code model, context tokens, and 5h/7d usage in the VS Code status bar. Supports native Claude VS Code transcripts.

commands.title: Claude Status: Disable Usage Bridge and Restore Previous StatusLine

claudeVscodeStatus.refreshInterval.description: Seconds between local cache checks. No network requests are made.

claudeVscodeStatus.showTokens.description: Show current input tokens / context window size next to Context %.

claudeVscodeStatus.defaultContextWindowS.description: Fallback context window size for native Claude VS Code transcripts when the transcript does not expose an explicit window size.

claudeVscodeStatus.warnTokens.description: Yellow text at or above this many context tokens (first tier). 0 disables it.

claudeVscodeStatus.hotTokens.description: Orange background at or above this many context tokens (second tier). 0 disables it.

claudeVscodeStatus.errorTokens.description: Red background at or above this many context tokens (top tier). 0 disables it.

claudeVscodeStatus.debug.description: Write session-detection diagnostics to the 'Claude Code Status' output channel.
